notes: Separate historical Iraqi CSO construction-worker wage reference, retrieved 2026-10-30. It has 90 derived hourly benchmarks from 15 governorates × 6 worker categories; it is not part of the default catalogue epoch and is excluded from current candidate cost estimates.

iraq.cso.construction-wages-2024.publisher: Iraqi Ministry of Planning, Central Statistical Organization, Construction and Building Statistics Directorate
iraq.cso.construction-wages-2024.access: Official CSO 2024 Construction and Building Statistics bulletin, Table 7, printed page 9, reports average daily wages in IQD/person/workday for six construction-worker categories across 15 listed governorates. Hourly values are derived by dividing the published daily rate by an explicit 8-hour working day. These are historical construction-worker base-wage statistics, not factory charge-out rates; employer burden, benefits, overtime and training are excluded. The bulletin does not include the Kurdistan Region.
iraq.cso.construction-wages-2024.licence: Public source page; extraction and redistribution terms unassessed
iraq.cso.construction-wages-2024.geographic_scope: 15 listed Iraqi governorates; Kurdistan Region not tabulated
iraq.cso.construction-wages-2024.table: Table 7: Average worker wages by governorate for 2024
iraq.cso.construction-wages-2024.hour_normalization: Published IQD/person/workday divided by explicit 8 working hours/day
iraq.cso.construction-wages-2024.methodology: Historical wage context only; not inflation-adjusted and not used in current candidate cost estimates
